title: ScreenGuard v0.1.1 — Action Required
body:
Important: If you are on beta.4+ or v0.1.1 (Release 1), please update to v0.1.1 Release 2 using your system package manager (apt, dnf, pacman) or by downloading the package from GitHub.

A minor download-path issue was identified in the in-app updater that prevented background update archives from saving properly. Release 2 resolves this completely.

Key highlights in this release:
• Full Settings Hub — Light/Dark/System themes, custom audio cues, data management
• Daily Screen-Time Goals — Visual goal bar, 50%/100%/overtime milestone alerts
• Pomodoro Focus Cycles — Work/break alternation, pause/resume, cycle counter
• Safe Focus Enforcement — Minimization & persistent warning dialogs protect unsaved work
• Steam & Proton Support — Native game titles, custom icons, proper process handling
• C Native Helpers — Direct D-Bus notifications, robust process management, and watchdog

How is the new release working for you? We would love to hear what you like and what needs improvement!

title: What's next for ScreenGuard? 🎄
body:
Hey everyone! 👋

First off, a huge thank you to everyone using ScreenGuard across the globe! We now have daily active users across 15+ countries relying on ScreenGuard for Linux screen time tracking, application limits, and focus mode.

As we plan the next major updates, I'd love to share our upcoming roadmap and get your input on where to take the app next.

🎄 1. Cinnamon Wayland Support — Development Started!

With Linux Mint and Cinnamon actively pushing Wayland forward, we have officially started development on native Cinnamon Wayland window tracking!

• Target Release: This Christmas (December 2026).
• Linux Mint is currently our single largest user base, so making ScreenGuard work seamlessly on Cinnamon Wayland is our top compositor priority for the holidays.

⏳ 2. KDE Plasma Wayland Status

Unfortunately, native KDE Plasma Wayland support has to be pushed further back into early next year. Due to KWin's Wayland security isolation model and the complexity of KWin scripting D-Bus interfaces, it requires more dedicated testing before it meets our stability standards. (Contributors familiar with KWin scripting are always welcome!)

🎨 3. New UI Sneak Peek (Beta Available)

We've been working on a fresh, modern redesign of the ScreenGuard interface:

• Cleaner dashboard layouts with improved daily charts and focus session controls.
• Refined theme support with better integration into system light/dark accents.

You don't have to switch off stable to help! Check out the preview screenshots in the README and share your thoughts — or drop your bug reports, feature ideas, and UI suggestions in the Discussions thread!
